collections.name: The Diamond
collections.blurb: The Fraternity's magazine, published 1878-1887 and again from 1920 to 2015. The single richest record of Psi Upsilon life: chapter letters, alumni notes, obituaries, convention coverage and photographs.

collections.name: Convention Records
collections.blurb: Official proceedings of the annual Convention, 1872 to 1972. Delegate rolls, reports, resolutions and addresses.

collections.name: Annals of Psi Upsilon
collections.blurb: The 1941 centennial history of the Fraternity, issued in twelve parts.

collections.name: Printed Histories
collections.blurb: Book-length histories of the Fraternity and of individual chapters, from 1883 onward.

collections.name: The Review
collections.blurb: A short-lived newsletter published by The Psi Upsilon Review Company of Detroit, 1895-1896.

collections.name: Songbooks
collections.blurb: Psi Upsilon printed its first songbook in 1849. These are the bound editions published by the Executive Council.

collections.name: Member Education
collections.blurb: Pledge manuals and editions of the College Tablet used to teach new members.

collections.name: Special Collections
collections.blurb: Material that doesn't fit the serial runs: committee presentations, one-off documents and curiosities.
